chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him and his family) to 'Abdullah ibn al-Abbas;
Its mention has already preceded with a difference from this narration.
ai.seo_question: What does the note about the letter to Ibn Abbas indicate regarding its previous appearance?
ai.summary: This bibliographical note in *Nahj al-Balagha* highlights the scholarly practice of preserving variant readings (*tawātur*) of Imam Ali’s correspondence, ensuring that minor textual differences do not obscure the core message. It underscores the meticulous compilation by Sharif al-Radi, who distinguished between duplicate entries to provide readers with a comprehensive view of the Imam’s epistolary style and rhetorical nuances.
